description: This file defines common utilities, data structures, and macros used in the ANGLE project's shader translator component, including custom string, vector, and map types with pool allocators, as well as hash functions and source location structures.

classes.name: TSourceLoc
classes.description: Structure representing source code location with file and line number ranges.

classes.name: TVector
classes.description: Template class for a vector with pool allocator support.

classes.name: TUnorderedMap
classes.description: Template class for an unordered map with pool allocator support.

classes.name: TMap
classes.description: Template class for a map with pool allocator support.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Converts an integer to a TString.

methods.name: AllocatePoolCharArray
methods.description: Allocates a null-terminated char array in the global pool.

methods.name: InitializeStream
methods.description: Creates and initializes a stream with the classic locale.
